messages:
maya: Noted some KMS-wrapped ciphertexts in partner CI artifacts (meta.json). wrapping_key_id shows wrap-key-v1 (old). No plaintext found but we should sweep.

sam: Can you paste a redacted header + artifact path?

maya: artifact://partner-repo/builds/2026-03-21/1234/meta.json
redacted:
```
{
  "ciphertext": "REDACTED...",
  "wrapping_key_id": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/wrap-key-v1"
}
```

security-bot: Created INC-2026-045 (artifact-store suspected exposure). Triage here.

liam: Proposed quick plan:
1) audit key usage (30d)
2) unpublish & set retention=0 for affected artifacts
3) run rewrap to wrap ciphertext with wrap-key-v2
4) update Vault/KMS bindings and RBAC
5) rotate any tokens that could push artifacts

sarah: I'll own IAM/RBAC changes. Will restrict new key to vault-sa and ci-rotator-sa and open PR for fast review.

alex: Running audit query now, will drop CSV of affected artifacts and SA list to GCS.

maya: Short-term mitigation: revoke partner-ci publish perms and unshare links. Also notify partner that builds may be purged.

devops-oncall: Can schedule rewrap at 22:00 PST tonight (low traffic). Need dry-run earlier and rollback plan.

sam: After rewrap we must update Vault transit config and sealed-secrets controller references. Example: `vault write sys/kms/config key_id=projects/.../cryptoKeys/wrap-key-v2`.

liam: Rewrap job outline: for each artifact -> fetch metadata -> gcloud kms decrypt (old key) -> gcloud kms encrypt (new key) -> atomic write back -> log mapping. I'll do a dry-run at 20:30 PST (no writes), live at 22:00 if green. Keep wrap-key-v1 enabled for 1 hour post-change.

alex: Audit found 14 objects across 3 partner repos + 2 internal pipelines. Service accounts: partner-ci-sa@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com, buildbot@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com. CSV uploaded: gs://infra-audit/inc-2026-045/affected.csv

maya: Good. @devops-oncall please disable retention and remove public links for those artifacts.

devops-oncall: Done. Logged in ops-log#4532.

sarah: IAM PR opened (internal link). Requested expedited review and added conditional bindings. Also looping in compliance/legal.

sam: Reminder: check kustomize overlays for sealed-secrets controller referencing wrap-key-v1.

security-bot: INC-2026-045 status updated -> owners assigned: alex (audit), liam (rewrap), sarah (RBAC). ETA tonight.

liam: Dry-run started at 20:30 PST, posting results shortly.

alex: Shared artifact manifest and CSV with liam/sarah.

maya: Post-rewrap tasks: grep logs for accidental token/plaintext patterns, rotate any tokens that could have published artifacts.

sam: Smoke tests after rotation:
- vault status
- gcloud kms keys describe wrap-key-v2
- sample encrypt/decrypt against new key

security-bot: Incident in-progress. Will post final update after live rewrap or if blockers encountered.

sarah: Compliance checklist attached to the ticket (retention proof, partner notif, audit export, rotation proof).

maya: Thanks everyone. Ping here if you need quick artifact lookups.

liam: Dry-run completed, no decrypt errors. Will run live at 22:00. Rollback: restore from backup + re-enable wrap-key-v1.

sam: Channel stays open for rollback comms. :thumbsup:
